guidebook.league-of-crafters.landing: Welcome to the League of Crafters guide! This book contains everything you need to know about the mod, from stat conversions to items and world generation.
category.league-of-crafters.stats.desc: Learn how League of Legends stats convert to Minecraft attributes
category.league-of-crafters.world_gen.de: Information about camps, monsters, and world spawning
category.league-of-crafters.items.desc: A complete catalog of all League of Crafters items
entry.league-of-crafters.stat_conversion: League of Crafters converts League of Legends stats into Minecraft attributes. Attack Damage (AD) maps to Minecraft's Attack Damage. Ability Power (AP) increases magic damage. Armor and Magic Resist reduce incoming physical and magic damage respectively.

Ability Haste reduces cooldown timers. Critical Strike Chance gives a chance to deal bonus damage. Life Steal heals a percentage of damage dealt. Move Speed is converted to Minecraft's movement speed attribute. More detailed stat interactions are documented on each item's page.
entry.league-of-crafters.camps.page1: Jungle camps spawn randomly in forest, plains, and mountain biomes. Each camp contains a group of jungle monsters that respawn after being cleared. Defeating these monsters rewards League Coins, which can be used to craft the League of Crafters Guidebook and other items.
entry.league-of-crafters.blue_sentinel.p: The Blue Sentinel is a jungle monster found in camps. Defeating it drops League Coins. More details about its stats and behavior will be added as development continues.
